title: Logarithmic bound at the critical parameter
statement:
Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be monotone and nonconstant. For $p\in\mathbb R$, write $Q_f(p)$ for the biased minus-probability polynomial of $f$. Suppose $0<p_0\le pc$, $0<pc<1$, and $Q_f(pc)=1/2$. Then
\[
\log Q_f(p_0)-\frac12\log p_0\le \log\frac12-\frac12\log pc.
\]
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
